candidates.observed: The closed model has an initial edge to HumanDriving and a Power_On edge from HumanDriving to Autonomous; no transition has source system and target HumanDriving.

candidates.reason: The target Autonomous is exact, but the required source system is not an exact closed-model transition source. The corresponding closed transition originates at HumanDriving.
candidates.requirement_quote: when front_distance > 10, auto transport to autonomous state

candidates.title: Front-distance transition has the wrong closed-model relation

candidates.basis: NL4.2 contract; exact source inventory transition tr_0005; FCSTM transition line 17 from AutonomousActive to HumanDriving with Human_Steering_Cmd and null guard; no system-sourced carrier has the stated condition.

candidates.reason: The target HumanDriving and Human_Steering_Cmd consumer are exact, but the required source system is not represented as an exact closed-model source and the closed carrier has no guard. The supplied combined relation is therefore not established.
